title: 第一卷 第5章 马皇后
slug: 大明死谏一百次老朱破防了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

他故意提高了音量，确保窗外的影子能听得清清楚楚。

“从诏狱出来就跟上了，飞鱼服，绣春刀，一看就是老手。”

“少爷您小点声！”福伯急得直跺脚。

“没事，”程壑川又喝了口茶，声音不大不小，刚好能传到院子里，“老朱说了，给我三个月重修《元史》。至少这三个月，他不会杀我。”

窗外的影子顿了一下。

程壑川嘴角微微上扬。

他要的就是这个效果。

在诏狱里他就想明白了，这三个月他最大的优势不是修史的能力，而是他知道朱元璋在看。

锦衣卫的监视是一把双刃剑。既然是监视，就一定会把他的话传回去。

那他为什么不通过锦衣卫，直接给朱元璋递话呢？

“福伯，家里有什么吃的？”程壑川转移话题，“饿了一天了。”

“有有有，”福伯连忙点头，“老奴去热饭，少爷您等着。”

老头转身要走，又折返回来，眼巴巴地看着他：“少爷，您真的没事？”

“没事。”

“陛下……真的不杀您？”

“现在不杀，”程壑川想了想，补充道，“三个月后杀不杀，看我把《元史》修得怎么样。”

福伯脸上的表情比哭还难看：“那您怎么还跟没事人一样？”

程壑川笑了：“不然呢？哭有用吗？跪有用吗？跪了就能不死？”

福伯张了张嘴，最终什么也没说，转身去了厨房。

程壑川一个人坐在堂屋里，目光扫过这间屋子。

墙上挂着一幅字，写着“清风明月”四个字。

字迹端正平和，跟原主这个人的性格倒是很配。

胆小、谨慎、不爱出头、见谁都笑。

这样的人，被吓死在朝堂上，倒也不算意外。

但程壑川不是他。

“少爷，”福伯端着一个食盒进来，一边摆菜一边絮叨，“您不在家的时候，隔壁的张御史来过，说是要借您的书。后面那条巷子的李翰林也来过，说是请您喝酒。老奴都打发走了。”

程壑川夹了一筷子青菜，嚼了两口，含混地问：“这些人平时跟原……跟我关系怎么样？”

“张御史跟您是同科进士，交情还算不错。李翰林嘛……”福伯撇了撇嘴，“就是个见风使舵的。以前没怎么走动，今天突然跑来，八成是听说您进了诏狱，想打听消息。”

程壑川点了点头。

Page (1/3)

He deliberately raised his voice to ensure that the shadow outside the window could be heard clearly.

"I followed him right after he came out of prison. He wears a flying fish suit and a embroidered spring knife. He looks like an expert at first sight."

"Master, please lower your voice!" Uncle Fu stamped his feet anxiously.

"It's okay," Cheng Hechuan took another sip of tea. His voice was not too loud or too quiet, just enough to be heard in the courtyard, "Old Zhu said, give me three months to rewrite "Yuan History". At least during these three months, he won't kill me."

The shadow outside the window paused.

The corners of Cheng Hechuan's mouth rose slightly.

This is the effect he wants.

He figured it out in prison. His biggest advantage in the past three months was not his ability to compile history, but that he knew Zhu Yuanzhang was watching.

Jin Yiwei's surveillance is a double-edged sword.Since it was surveillance, his words would definitely be sent back.

Then why didn't he pass the message to Zhu Yuanzhang directly through Jin Yiwei?

"Uncle Fu, what's there to eat at home?" Cheng Hechuan changed the subject, "I've been hungry all day."

"Yes, yes, yes," Uncle Fu nodded quickly, "Old slave, go and heat up the food. Master, please wait."

The old man turned to leave, then turned back and looked at him helplessly: "Master, are you really okay?"

"It's okay."

"Your Majesty...really don't want to kill you?"

"If you don't kill me now," Cheng Hechuan thought for a moment, then added, "Whether you kill him or not in three months will depend on how well I am able to revise the History of the Yuan Dynasty."

The expression on Fu Bo's face was uglier than crying: "Then why are you still acting like you're fine?"

Cheng Hechuan smiled: "Otherwise? Is it useful to cry? Is it useful to kneel? Can you not die if you kneel?"

Uncle Fu opened his mouth, but finally said nothing and turned around and went to the kitchen.

Cheng Hechuan sat alone in the main room and glanced across the room.

There is a picture hanging on the wall with the four words "Qingfengmingyue" written on it.

The handwriting is neat and peaceful, which matches the personality of the original owner very well.

Timid, cautious, doesn't like to show off, and laughs at everyone he sees.

It is not surprising that such a person was scared to death in the court.

But Cheng Hechuan is not him.

"Master," Uncle Fu came in with a food box and babbled while setting the dishes, "while you were not at home, Zhang Yushi from next door came over and said he wanted to borrow your book. Li Hanlin from the alley behind also came over and said he wanted to buy you a drink. The old slaves were sent away."

Cheng Hechuan picked up a piece of green vegetables with chopsticks, chewed two mouthfuls, and asked vaguely: "How do these people usually have a relationship with Yuan... and me?"

"Zhang Yushi and you are Jinshi in the same department, and we have a pretty good friendship. Li Hanlin..." Uncle Fu curled his lips, "He is just a man who adapts to the wind. He didn't move around much before, but he suddenly came here today. Most likely, he heard that you were in prison and wanted to inquire about the news."

Cheng Hechuan nodded.
